unsupported_features.rationale: Bundle and parent-child aggregation are outside the first Core-DP delivery contract.
Material transformation semantics are outside Offer -> Match -> Transfer delivery proof.
Transactions and payments are OUT for Core-DP.
General association modeling is deferred until profile-specific DPP/VC work.
IoT sensor streams are not part of the lab-only foundation.
Core-DP validates only the conservative fixture fields and does not maintain a full EPCIS vocabulary registry.
Only the fixture business steps listed in the profile README are used.
